definitions.explanation: A style of painting that uses only black ink, expressing form and depth through gradations of shading rather than color.

examples.japanese: {水墨画|すいぼくが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To paint an ink wash painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水墨画|すいぼくが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{掛|か}けて⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: An ink wash painting hangs in the alcove.

examples.japanese: {水墨画|すいぼくが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{濃淡|のうたん}→濃淡：05562_noutan⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ink wash painting expresses a landscape using only shades of black ink.

notes:
A painting done in black ink alone, using the depth of shading (⟦{濃淡|のうたん}→濃淡：05562_noutan⟧) in place of color. Introduced from China and developed in Japan, especially in the Muromachi period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水墨画|すいぼくが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint in ink wash style
- {水墨画|すいぼくが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧: ink wash painting technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {墨絵|すみえ}: ink drawing — a near-synonym, slightly more everyday in tone
- ⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧: Japanese-style painting — the broader category, which uses mineral pigments and color
